section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Self-Compassion Scale (SCS), detailing its positive and negative components, subscales (self-kindness, common humanity, mindfulness; self-judgment, isolation, over-identification), and its 26-item self-report format. It reports good internal reliability with Cronbach's alphas of 0.92 for the original and 0.89 for the Portuguese versions. For the present study, only the three positive subscales were combined into a composite measure (SCS_SC), which showed a Cronbach's alpha of 0.91.
